identity.title: Make process-backend output-limit and timeout precedence deterministic

values.summary: Diagnose the deadline/output observation order, implement one bounded server-owned precedence rule, prove both terminal cleanup paths repeatedly, then run required Runtime proof and exact-head review.

steps.action: Map and correct process-backend deadline versus output-limit arbitration.
Add and repeatedly run focused pressure and cleanup proof.
Run required Runtime validation, strict Clippy, Observatory proof, and exact-head review.

invariants: Timeout remains fail-closed when no oversized output is observable.
Output artifacts are removed on every terminal path.
risks: Inspecting output too early could misclassify an ordinary timeout.
Inspecting after cleanup could erase precedence evidence.
A fixture-only delay could conceal the production race.
stop_conditions: Any required change overlaps #112 authority or #244 cleanup hooks.
The deterministic rule weakens ordinary timeout, cancellation, or cleanup semantics.
Required Runtime validation exposes a distinct unrelated blocker.
